scope: Current main CuTe vs actual default SDPA, B1/H16 contiguous BHSD, FP16/BF16 dense/causal. Resident GPU work through warmed CUDA graphs; forward retains autograd and joint includes all three gradients. CPU dispatch, compilation and full-model costs excluded.

protocol.reference: Full-length centered FP64 on identical rounded inputs, two-head chunks.
protocol.accuracy_gate: Each output/dQ/dK/dV norm-relative error below 1% BF16 or 0.5% FP16; exact zero when reference norm is zero.
protocol.kernel_verification: Separate eager and CUDA-graph profiler passes after uninstrumented timing.
protocol.phase_note: Backward retains a forward graph. Separately timed medians need not sum to joint.
protocol.activity_scope: The actual_launched_kernels lists contain CUDA profiler activity names, including copies and memsets as well as function kernels.
